projects.title: Intelligent Tool Control and History System
projects.description: Development of a web system and API for industrial asset management using Industry 4.0 technologies. I worked on building the API and the web front-end, being responsible for the products and tools module structure, and assisting the team in defining the database schema for warehouse control.

projects.title: IF-Club
projects.description: Developed a project focused on academic integration through the creation of a social network for researchers at IFMA – Campus Caxias. The platform was designed to connect students and professors from different fields, enabling collaboration, idea sharing, and interaction on research and innovation projects. The initiative contributed to improving communication and encouraging interdisciplinary work within the institution.

projects.title: Virtual Store
projects.description: Development of a full-featured e-commerce mobile application using Flutter and Firebase. I worked on building the complete product catalog, shopping cart flow, user authentication with Firebase Auth, real-time database integration with Cloud Firestore, and order tracking features.
